share.photoTooLarge: That photo is too large. Please choose one under 8 MB.
share.firstNameHint: Only your first name is shown - never your surname.

share.headlinePlaceholder: e.g. Caregiver with 8 years of elderly care

share.consent3: Your surname, phone number, email, address, NIC, passport number and documents will never be shown.
